INTRODUCING OUR CUSTOM DESIGNER SERVICE

CUSTOMISE YOUR OWN OUTFIT

We'll help you customise the outfit of your dreams whether it be traditional Indian or modern Indian

CHOOSE FROM ANY COLOUR, DESIGN OR STYLE

Our designer team can design a hand-made dress unique for you with custom embroidery, beautiful quality fabrics and colour of your choice

Fitness happens at every size

Whatever size you are, wearing Walia Jones can make you look beautiful both inside and out.

WE ALSO DESIGN MEN'S WEAR AND BRIDAL PARTY OUTFITS

From matching men's wear to bridal party outfits, we can help you to achieve your wedding theme dreams
